pins.definition: Of poor quality, unpleasant, or not satisfactory.
Unpleasant, of low quality, or not going well; the opposite of 'gut'.
Not good at something; of low quality or skill.

situation: A baker at his counter stares in disappointment at a tray of muffins he just pulled from the oven that have all turned a charcoal black and shriveled into pucks.
subject: the poor quality of the results
brief: A baker in a cluttered, warm-toned kitchen stands over a metal baking sheet; on the sheet sit six perfectly round but impossibly shriveled, blackened, and cracked muffins that contrast sharply with the golden, fluffy loaves of bread visible in the background. The baker holds a pair of oven mitts and looks at the tray with a comically dejected expression.
